scope: Descriptive convenience samples; AI visual reviews, not independent human certification. Generation guidance and repair workflows are separate experiments.

limits: Known targets, manual coordinates and manually planned 6–16-pixel masks; detection and mask automation unmeasured.
Seven targets share six originals; selected known error patterns, not a population sample or held-out benchmark.
A versus B changes edit unit and visual-reference conditioning, so it does not isolate reference conditioning.
A/B results are hard-composited into frozen regions; full generated images are not guaranteed to preserve the rest of the slide.
Uncertain baselines are reported separately; target pass on these is not counted as a confirmed repair gain.

evidence_availability: Aggregate results and helper tests are public. Raw generated images, font files and records containing machine-local paths are not part of the package.

stroke_holdout.input_kind: Controlled font renders; not AI generation
stroke_holdout.protocol: Known correct source copy; hidden error labels/coordinates; one applied candidate per image; fixed implementation and outcomes before truth reveal.
limits: 18 controlled font-rendered cards, not AI generation or natural-error prevalence. 8 simple vowel errors, 2 intentional difficult cases and 8 normal controls.
Operators saw source text and input pixels but not private error labels, coordinates or clean font renders. One applied candidate per image; no outcome-driven mask tuning.
Location and stroke selection were performed by agents; automatic glyph segmentation was not tested or implemented.
One retained typo was falsely read as correct by the operator, raw OCR and independent AI audit. Exact fixture labels and post-seal isolated-glyph inspection retain it as an error.
Candidate evaluation combines operator full-frame review, independent AI full-frame/glyph audit, and a truth-aware isolated-glyph read by root. No independent human review.
The repaired glyphs differ from canonical clean font renders. Visual legibility and design preservation do not establish exact font restoration.
Wall time includes long approval/scheduler gaps and interleaved cases; active operator time was not measured and no speed comparison is made.

After the frozen execution was sealed, invalid/empty OCR geometry was changed to retain text differences and defer coordinate mapping to visual review. This is covered by a regression test, not claimed as an improvement on the 18-case detection result.

new_generated_repair_cases.note: The 2 new generated slides were intentionally prompted with errors; they are reported separately and have no rerolls. One was repaired and one was deferred.

mechanical_validation.post_study_fix: Invalid or empty OCR geometry now preserves copy differences and requests visual location instead of terminating the locator.
